info.title: Invexa Retail API - extracted modules
info.description: Week 8 (API Modularization and Contract Generation): a versioned OpenAPI contract for the endpoints that have been extracted out of the god routers (routes/core.ts, routes/operations-extension.ts) into their own thin route + command/query service + repository modules. This is NOT a spec for the whole API - most of core.ts/operations-extension.ts's ~180 remaining routes are tracked as extraction backlog in docs/route-ownership-matrix.md and are deliberately not documented here yet, so this contract never silently drifts ahead of what has actually been modularized. Extending it is part of extracting the next module. Week 10 adds the Item Search / Stock Detail / Adjustment-Reversal vertical slice (routes/items.ts) - additive to, not a replacement for, core.ts's existing unpaginated GET /items. Week 13 adds the Week 11 staged-import-lifecycle endpoints (routes/imports.ts) and the Week 12 reporting/exception-dashboard endpoints (routes/reports.ts) to the contract - both existed in code before this week but were not yet documented here (see AGENTS.md's OpenAPI contract row: 'covers only extracted routes... grows as each future module is extracted'). Plan 10/10 (Phase 3-8) adds the virtual bundle/kit endpoints (routes/bundles.ts), the optional two-factor sign-in endpoints (routes/enterprise-auth.ts /auth/2fa/*), the stock reconciliation endpoints (routes/command-center.ts /ops/reconciliation*), and documents the X-Mutation-Id exactly-once replay header (lib/mutation-idempotency.ts) as a shared parameter. Auth catch-up adds sign-in (/auth/login, /auth/send-otp, /auth/verify-otp) and session (/auth/refresh-token, /auth/logout, /auth/logout-all) endpoints. Operations catch-up adds /ops/sync-health, the webhook subscription and delivery endpoints (company scoped), and the approval-request endpoints. Adds the Entity 360 read model and the one-time web handoff used by the native app.

IdempotencyKey.name: requestId
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied idempotency key. Mutating endpoints that accept one return the original result on replay instead of double-posting (ADR-006). Most endpoints in this contract take it as a body field, not a query parameter - see each operation.

MutationId.name: X-Mutation-Id
MutationId.description: Exactly-once replay key, created once when the person acts and reused on every retry (including after a restart). 8-128 characters of letters, digits and . _ : -. A retry with the same id and the same request returns the original 2xx response with `Idempotent-Replay: true` and does not run again; a concurrent duplicate gets 409 MUTATION_IN_PROGRESS with Retry-After; the same id for a different request is 422 MUTATION_ID_REUSED.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The stable error shape (ADR-006 / lib/errors.ts's DomainError) that new and extracted code returns. Not yet the shape of every endpoint in the full API - see AGENTS.md's Error catalog row.

error.description: Human-readable message. May change wording without notice - do not branch on it.

code.description: Stable, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Clients branch on this.

traceId.description: Correlates this rejection to server logs and the audit trail.

LegacyErrorMessage.description: The older, pre-Week-7 error shape most of these endpoints still use for validation/role failures (see each operation's 4xx responses for which shape applies).

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor (the last item's id). Pass back verbatim as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null means no more pages.

reversalOf.description: The id of the movement this one reverses, if any.

ReconciliationStatus.description: Whether StockLedger.onHand for one (lot, location) agrees with the sum of every StockMovement journal row for it - computed live from the canonical journal/projection (ADR-001), the same way scripts/reconcile-stock-journal.mjs does.

qtyDelta.description: Positive to add stock, negative to remove. Never zero.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated (e.g. a UUID). Retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of posting again.

duplicate.description: True if this idempotency key had already been posted - the movement/balance below are the ORIGINAL result, not a new post.

ImportBatch.description: Week 11's staged import lifecycle state machine row.

checkpointRowNumber.description: Highest row number committed so far - a crash/restart resumes past this, never before it.

ImportRawRow.description: One staged row before validation - already-parsed JSON, not a raw CSV/file upload (see docs/week11-import-staging-commit-reverse.md's 'Not done').

branchName.description: Required for SALES/SALES_RETURN/OPENING_STOCK - ignored for PURCHASE, which always posts at Head Office.

duplicate.description: true if this file's checksum matched an existing batch - the returned batch is that existing one, not a new one.

breached.description: Open cases whose dueAt has passed.

buildable.description: Whole bundles that can be built from sellable component stock (on hand minus reserved).

configured.description: False when the server has no TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

challengeToken.description: 5-minute single-purpose token; never accepted as an access token.

mismatches.description: Rows whose journal does not add up to the balance. Any value above zero is a breach.

noJournalHistory.description: Legacy balances with no journal at all; a reported baseline, not an alert.

refreshToken.description: Native clients only; browsers use the HttpOnly refresh cookie.

available.description: False when the server runs without a database.

stuck.description: Mutation receipts still IN_PROGRESS past the stale window; never deleted automatically.

valueAtStake.description: Decimal(14,2) in the database, a JSON number on the wire.

get.summary: List transfers visible to the caller's access context (location-scoped).

200.description: Transfers the caller can see by source or destination location access.

post.summary: Request a transfer. Reserves source stock atomically before the transfer row is created.

400.description: Validation failed (bad payload, wrong destination type for a store user's request, etc.).

422.description: Insufficient stock to reserve - the stable DomainError envelope (ADR-006/Week 7).

post.summary: Create a branch. Admin only.

patch.summary: Update a branch's editable fields. Code is immutable. Admin only.

post.summary: Archive a branch. Blocked if any of its locations have on-hand stock, open transfers, or pending work assignments.

409.description: Branch has active stock, open transfers, or pending work.

get.summary: Server-paginated item search (cursor-based). Tested to 5,000+ items (Week 10).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text match against item name or code.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The previous page's `nextCursor` - never construct this client-side.

get.summary: Branch balances, lots, movement history and reconciliation status for one item, from the canonical journal/projection.

403.description: The item belongs to a different tenant (caught by enforceOperationalCompanyScope before this handler runs).

post.summary: Guided manual adjustment. Posts through InventoryPostingService with a required client-supplied idempotency key - a retried request returns the original result (200, duplicate: true) instead of posting twice.

200.description: Duplicate of an already-posted idempotency key - the original result, not a new post.

400.description: Missing/invalid locationId, lotId, qtyDelta, reason or idempotencyKey.

403.description: The item/location belongs to a different tenant.

404.description: Item, location or lot not found for this tenant.

post.summary: Posts an equal-and-opposite movement. The original movement row is never edited. Reversing an already-reversed movement fails (409), and retrying a reversal request is itself idempotent via a derived key.

200.description: Duplicate reversal request - the original reversal result.

404.description: Movement not found for this tenant.

409.description: This movement has already been reversed.

post.summary: Stage a new import batch (Week 11). Rejects a byte-identical re-upload as a duplicate rather than creating a second batch.

200.description: Duplicate file - returns the existing batch instead of creating a new one.

404.description: Not found or belongs to another company.

post.summary: Read-only per-row validation (item/lot/branch resolution, quantity/date parsing) - no stock is touched.

409.description: Batch is not in a state that can be validated.

post.summary: Queues the batch for commit and returns immediately (202) - the background worker (lib/import-worker.ts) does the actual posting through InventoryPostingService, so a 5,000+ row file never holds the request open.

409.description: Batch is not VALIDATED (or was an ALL_OR_NOTHING batch with invalid rows, and has already moved straight to FAILED).

get.summary: Downloadable, spreadsheet-operator-safe failure export - one {rowNumber, field, code, message} record per row error.

post.summary: Reverses every committed row's movement (equal-and-opposite post via InventoryPostingService). Safe to call twice - an already-reversed row is tolerated, not double-reversed.

409.description: Batch has nothing committed to reverse, or is already REVERSED.

get.summary: Week 12's exception-first dashboard: exception queue summary, stock-risk summary, and per-queue SLA backlog, all tenant-scoped. See docs/week12-reporting-exception-dashboard.md for the 'at risk'/SLA definitions.
Cursor-paginated open ExceptionCase rows, soonest-due first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The previous page's nextCursor - never construct this client-side.

get.summary: A virtual bundle's components and how many can be built now.

200.description: The definition (isBundle false when the item is not a bundle).

404.description: Item or location not found (also for another company's id).

400.description: Empty, self-referencing, duplicate, non-positive or nested definition.

404.description: Item or a component not found (also for another company's id).

409.description: The item is already a component of another bundle.

post.summary: Start enrolment: returns the setup key and otpauth URI.
Confirm enrolment with a first code; returns the backup codes once.
Turn two-factor off; needs a current or backup code.
Second step of sign-in for an account with two-factor on.

code.description: 6-digit authenticator code or an unused backup code.

200.description: Signed in: access token (and refresh token for native clients).

401.description: Invalid or expired challenge, or code not accepted.

get.summary: The latest stock reconciliation for the caller's company (journal sum vs balance).

200.description: Latest run (null before the first) and whether it breaches the SLO.

post.summary: Run a reconciliation now for the caller's company (admin). Read-only: never edits stock or history.
Sign in with email and password. Accounts with two-factor on get a challenge instead of a session.

200.description: A session, or a TwoFactorChallenge when a second step is required.

post.summary: Request a sign-in code. The answer is identical whether or not the email has an account.

429.description: Too many requests for this email.

503.description: Code delivery is not configured on this server.

post.summary: Exchange a 6-digit code for a session. A code works once.
Rotate the refresh token and get a new access token. Presenting an already-rotated token revokes the whole session family.

refreshToken.description: Native clients; browsers send the cookie.

200.description: New access token (and refresh token for native clients).

401.description: Invalid, expired or reused (REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED) token, or inactive user.

post.summary: Revoke this session's refresh-token family.
Sign out of every device.

get.summary: Offline-command health for the caller's company: completed, in-flight and stuck mutation receipts.
The caller's company's webhook subscriptions (admin). Another company's hooks are never listed.

post.summary: Create a subscription. Events are delivered only for the caller's own company.

201.description: Created; the signing secret is shown once.

404.description: Not found (also for another company's id).

get.summary: Recent deliveries of the caller's company (admin).

post.summary: Replay a FAILED delivery with its stored payload.

409.description: Not found (also for another company's id) or not replayable.

get.summary: Approval requests of the caller's company.

post.summary: Approve or reject a pending request.

403.description: The caller's role is below the rule's required approver role.

409.description: Not found (also for another company's id) or already decided.

get.summary: Everything about one lot, location, transfer, count or user: summary, what it is connected to, and what happened. Read-only and company scoped.

404.description: Unknown type, missing id, another company's id, or (for users) a caller below a management role - all the same answer.

501.description: The server runs without a database.

post.summary: A one-time code (about a minute) that opens the web workspace already signed in, so a native app never shows a second login.
Trade the one-time code for a normal web session (HttpOnly refresh cookie). A code works once.

401.description: Invalid, used or expired code, or the user is no longer active.
